title: Theoretical physicists at S4 had exhausted gravity approaches

tellings.quote: >> Oh, for sure. Okay. I think they were exhausted by him. And I think they they kept going over that road and never got anywhere.

plain: Around 1988 or 1989, the theoretical physicists at S4, a secret site in Nevada, had tried every way to explain the craft there through gravity and gotten nowhere, says Bob Lazar, who says he worked there himself. "They kept going over that road and never got anywhere," he tells Michels, in a talk that also brings up the researcher Eric Weinstein and a man named Eric W. Davis. If true, the scientists studying the craft had hit a dead end in understanding how it worked.
